job.job_description:
Role Name: Senior Databricks Engineer

Designation : Senior Associate & Manger

Role Summary

Senior data engineer responsible for designing scalable Databricks lakehouse architecture, data modelling, reusable ETL frameworks, automation, and performance engineering.

Required Skills

B.Tech/B.E degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.
5-12+ years in Data Engineering; 4+ years in Databricks
Deep expertise in SparkSQL, PySpark, Python, Delta Lake
Strong cloud experience (AWS / Azure / GCP)
CI/CD implementation for data platforms
Strong performance tuning and workload optimization
Experience designing large-scale ETL pipeline
Strong understanding on SQL and data modeling skills

Good to Have

Experience with GenAI/Agentic AI for code conversion, automation, or metadata generation
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
Experience integrating on-prem DBs (Teradata/Oracle) with cloud

Key Responsibilities

Design Databricks Lakehouse medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
Architect reusable ingestion & transformation frameworks using Databricks and Enterprise level ETL / orchestration tool.
Preparing Physical data Model
Design and develop ingestion pipelines for various type of sources RDBMS, API, Files, etc.
